property_summary: For any input where the call to the provided caddress succeeds for all recipients, the return value of transfer should be true (not false).
transfer returns true for all valid inputs, including when the recipient array has only one element
The transfer function should succeed (return true and not revert) when the _tos array has exactly one element.
For any call to transfer where _tos array has length 1, the call does NOT revert.
For any call to transfer where _tos array has length exactly 1, the call should not revert.
For any call to transfer with a _tos array of length exactly 1, the call does not revert.
If all inner calls succeed, the transfer function returns true; if any reverts, the outer call also reverts.
For any input, after calling transfer, the function must revert if the inner call fails; the buggy version never reverts.
After calling transfer, the reference contract reverts if any inner call fails, while the mutated version does not revert.
For any input, after calling transfer, the reference contract reverts the transaction if any inner call fails; the buggy contract does not revert and returns true.
Calling transfer always reverts if any inner call fails, while the buggy version never reverts and returns true.
After calling transfer, the reference contract reverts if any inner call fails, while the buggy contract does not revert and returns true.
The reference C's transfer function does not change the contract's own balance, while the mutant changes it via delegatecall.
After calling transfer with a valid external contract, the contract's own code size remains unchanged (i.e., the delegatecall does not replace the contract code).
After calling transfer, the contract's own balance is unchanged.
After calling transfer, the second call to transfer with the same parameters must not revert if the first succeeded.
After calling transfer, the contract's own storage variable 'transfer' (the boolean return value) is always true.
